options.metric: Annual number of pedestrians killed in motor vehicle crashes
options.reason: Bars make the exact totals for each discrete year easy to compare directly.
options.interpretation: This framing answers the requested year-by-year count, with bar heights and labels showing the annual totals for 2013–2025. Bars are defensible for comparing discrete yearly counts; this view does not break totals down by borough or adjust for pedestrian exposure.

options.metric: Annual number of pedestrians killed in motor vehicle crashes
options.reason: A line chart makes the temporal pattern and year-to-year changes in the requested annual counts easy to follow.
options.interpretation: This framing answers the requested year-by-year count, and the labeled points show annual totals while the connecting line emphasizes how they change over time. It is defensible because the years are ordered observations in a time series; it does not break totals down by borough or adjust for pedestrian exposure.
